title: Invalid carrier promoting a KAIROS-style induced event schema to canonical ontology without review

expectedValidationFailure.reason: A KAIROS-style induced event schema, or a schema-match instance over it, proposes candidate multi-step event structure only. CHRONOS cannot promote it to canonical ontology, an evidence record, or a policy trigger, and cannot treat schema-match confidence as ground-truth event occurrence or causal proof, without owning-plane review.
